name: mnote_create_note
description: Create a note. `title` is the note title; `body` is the content as plain MARKDOWN (headings, lists, code fences, tables, task lists) — write clean, well-structured markdown. `categories` is an optional array of category ids to tag it with (from mnote_list_categories). The slug is derived from the title (auto-deduped). Requires the write scope (403 otherwise). Returns the created note including its new slug.

categories.description: Optional category ids to tag the note with.
